{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Ccs1hG1uJJMV6EDSFrpm7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FxuEsMUjYdHUmR7DE9BHJV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import csv\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom statistics import median\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/data.csv\"\n\n\ndef parse_amount(s: str) -> float:\n    # 1. Trim spaces; 2. empty -> NaN\n    t = (s or \"\").strip()\n    if t == \"\":\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    # 3. Negative if contains \"CR\", is enclosed in parentheses, or contains \"-\"\n    neg = (\"CR\" in t) or (t.startswith(\"(\") and t.endswith(\")\")) or (\"-\" in t)\n    # 4. Remove tokens C1/C2, keep only digits, \",\" and \".\"\n    u = t.replace(\"C1\", \"\").replace(\"C2\", \"\")\n    u = re.sub(r\"[^0-9.,]\", \"\", u)\n    # 5./6. Decimal separator resolution\n    if \",\" in u and \".\" in u:\n        # last-separator rule: the separator occurring last is the decimal\n        dec = \",\" if u.rfind(\",\") > u.rfind(\".\") else \".\"\n        oth = \".\" if dec == \",\" else \",\"\n        u = u.replace(oth, \"\")\n        i = u.rfind(dec)\n        u = u[:i].replace(dec, \"\") + \".\" + u[i + 1:]\n    elif \",\" in u or \".\" in u:\n        sep = \",\" if \",\" in u else \".\"\n        i = u.rfind(sep)\n        after = u[i + 1:]\n        if len(after) == 2:  # decimal only when exactly two digits follow\n            u = u[:i].replace(sep, \"\") + \".\" + after\n        else:\n            u = u.replace(sep, \"\")\n    # 7. Parse as float\n    try:\n        v = float(u)\n    except ValueError:\n        return float(\"nan\")\n    return -v if neg else v\n\n\ndef parse_notes(notes: str):\n    notes = notes or \"\"\n    m = re.search(r\"items=(\\d+)\", notes)\n    items = int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n    m = re.search(r\"adj=([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)%\", notes)\n    adj_pct = float(m.group(1)) / 100.0 if m else 0.0\n    m = re.search(r\"fee=([+-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\", notes)\n    fee = float(m.group(1)) if m else 0.0\n    waive = re.search(r\"waive=true\", notes, re.IGNORECASE) is not None\n    return items, adj_pct, fee, waive\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[str]:\n    rows = []\n    with open(DATA_PATH, newline=\"\") as f:\n        for idx, r in enumerate(csv.DictReader(f)):\n            base = parse_amount(r[\"amount_str\"])\n            items, adj_pct, fee, waive = parse_notes(r[\"notes\"])\n            if math.isnan(base):\n                net = float(\"nan\")\n            elif waive:\n                net = 0.0\n            else:\n                net = base * (1.0 + adj_pct) + fee\n            rows.append({\n                \"idx\": idx,\n                \"record_id\": r[\"record_id\"],\n                \"event_time\": r[\"event_time\"].strip(),\n                \"region\": r[\"region\"].strip(),\n                \"channel\": r[\"channel\"],\n                \"items\": items,\n                \"net\": net,\n            })\n\n    # Dedup: latest event_time (missing sorts lowest), then real net, then earlier file order\n    best = {}\n    for row in rows:\n        key = row[\"record_id\"]\n        cand = (row[\"event_time\"], 1 if math.isfinite(row[\"net\"]) else 0, -row[\"idx\"])\n        if key not in best or cand > best[key][0]:\n            best[key] = (cand, row)\n    deduped = [v[1] for v in best.values()]\n\n    # Filters\n    lo, hi = \"2025-10-01T00:00:00Z\", \"2025-12-31T23:59:59Z\"\n    kept = [\n        r for r in deduped\n        if r[\"event_time\"]\n        and lo <= r[\"event_time\"] <= hi\n        and r[\"channel\"].strip().lower() != \"phone\"\n        and math.isfinite(r[\"net\"])\n    ]\n\n    # Robust z per (region, month) using median/MAD\n    groups = {}\n    for r in kept:\n        groups.setdefault((r[\"region\"], r[\"event_time\"][:7]), []).append(r)\n    for members in groups.values():\n        med = median(m[\"net\"] for m in members)\n        mad = median(abs(m[\"net\"] - med) for m in members)\n        for m in members:\n            m[\"robust_z\"] = 0.0 if mad == 0 else 0.6745 * (m[\"net\"] - med) / mad\n\n    for r in kept:\n        items_eff = r[\"items\"] if r[\"items\"] is not None else 1\n        items_eff = max(items_eff, 1)\n        r[\"anomaly_score\"] = abs(r[\"robust_z\"]) * math.log1p(items_eff)\n        r[\"ts\"] = datetime.strptime(r[\"event_time\"], \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\") \\\n            .replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()\n\n    kept.sort(key=lambda r: (-r[\"anomaly_score\"], -abs(r[\"robust_z\"]),\n                             -r[\"ts\"], r[\"record_id\"]))\n    return [r[\"record_id\"] for r in kept[:10]]\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1591,"cache_read_input_tokens":27423,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1591,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"1e6188ea-9d13-4218-9816-da831edb1813","uuid":"50468bfe-a9e4-4f41-a509-3cde66ba639d","request_id":"req_011Ccs1hFD35nxfb3E8rY2ic"}
